instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after command, report, screenshot, trace, or log evidence proves the described behavior.

features.description: Current open-source readiness facts, blockers, phase boundaries, and validation surfaces are captured in durable harness files.
steps: Inspect root governance files, package metadata, CI workflows, README, DEPLOY, CHANGELOG, GAA-04 release report, demo-data paths, and git ignore rules.
Write a source packet and optimization plan that distinguish existing strengths from confirmed gaps.
Write an OSP-00 report and update loop state, progress log, continuity ledger, handoff, and next-window prompt.
features.evidence: docs/open_source_platform_optimization/optimization-plan.md and docs/open_source_platform_optimization/source-packet.md record current repo facts; docs/open_source_platform_optimization/reports/osp-00-open-source-baseline-audit-report.md records baseline evidence and unlocks OSP-01.
features.notes: Baseline planning is complete; implementation work remains in OSP-01 through OSP-04.

features.description: The repository exposes public legal, security, support, and contribution expectations at standard GitHub locations.
steps: Add or repair root LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, support guidance, and issue or pull-request templates.
Correct package project URLs so they point at the actual public repository instead of placeholder organization paths.
Verify files contain no secrets and preserve bundled third-party license notices.
features.evidence: Root LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SUPPORT.md, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml, and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml were added. pyproject.toml project URLs now point at https://github.com/misaya-yang/AI--Platfform. README.md links contribution and security files.
features.notes: No secret values are included in the governance files. License metadata and root LICENSE are aligned on MIT.

features.description: Contributors can run documented local checks and GitHub CI verifies the same core backend, frontend, compose, and harness gates.
steps: Review existing GitHub workflows and documented commands.
Align CI with the open-source contributor checks for Python lint/tests, frontend type/lint/build, Docker Compose static config, and harness validation.
Document command ownership, expected pass signals, and known environment blockers.
features.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml now runs shell syntax checks, focused ruff, 64 focused pytest script tests, docker compose config, portable harness JSON checks, frontend typecheck/lint/build, Playwright open-source route smoke, release doc checks, and demo seed dry-run. Local equivalents passed on 2026-06-18.
features.notes: Repo-wide ruff and format still have historical debt, so CI intentionally gates stable contributor-critical checks instead of the full existing codebase.

features.description: A first-time user can load meaningful demo data and verify the core product journeys without private data.
steps: Create or document a local-only demo seed path with dry-run behavior.
Cover knowledge dataset detail, exam detail, public share, public quiz, assistant unavailable-model, and assistant configured-model states.
Record browser or API smoke evidence and screenshots or artifact paths.
features.evidence: examples/demo-data/open-source-demo.sql, scripts/new/seed-demo-data.sh, docs/demo-data.md, Makefile seed-demo targets, tests/scripts/test_seed_demo_data.py, web/playwright.opensource.config.ts, and web/e2e/dynamic-route-render.spec.ts provide deterministic demo data and mocked route smoke. `scripts/new/seed-demo-data.sh --dry-run`, focused pytest, and `pnpm -C web e2e:opensource` passed locally.
features.notes: The route smoke proves frontend renderability without private data or model keys. Applying the SQL to a real local database remains an explicit local action via --apply.

features.description: Public releases are reproducible, auditable, rollback-ready, and blocked only by explicit unresolved launch gates or owner-approved waivers.
steps: Review Docker, SDK, changelog, versioning, and release workflows for tag-to-artifact traceability.
Write a release checklist that ties GAA-04 blockers, OSP evidence, rollback commands, and publishing approvals together.
Run whole-demand regression across completed OSP and GAA release-readiness evidence.
features.evidence: RELEASE.md documents pre-release gates, versioning, artifact workflows, tagging, post-release smoke, rollback, and release blockers. CHANGELOG.md records governance, CI, demo-data, and release-readiness additions. Docker and SDK publish workflows were reviewed. Terminal verification passed: git diff --check, OSP/GAA strict harness validation score 100, compose config, shell syntax, focused Ruff, 64 focused pytest tests, frontend typecheck/lint/build, 2 Playwright route-smoke tests, and demo seed dry-run.
features.notes: This passes repository-level public release preparation. Actual package publishing, release tags, production deployment, real env/provider alignment, and registry credentials remain owner-approved external gates.
